-- Local animation showroom. Combat damage and player controls are intentionally separate.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local rig=workspace:WaitForChild("blender666"):WaitForChild("AshenOathPreview")
local library=game:GetService("ServerStorage").blender666.Animations.AshenOath
local motors={}
local animator=rig.AnimationController.Animator
for _,m in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA("Motor6D") then motors[m.Name]=m end end
local clips={}
for _,sequence in ipairs(library:GetChildren()) do if sequence:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
    local frames={}
    for _,key in ipairs(sequence:GetKeyframes()) do
        local poses={}
        for _,p in ipairs(key:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("Pose") and motors[p.Name] then poses[p.Name]=p.CFrame end end
        if next(poses) then table.insert(frames,{time=key.Time,poses=poses}) end
    end
    table.sort(frames,function(a,b) return a.time<b.time end)
    if #frames>0 then clips[sequence.Name]={frames=frames,duration=frames[#frames].time,loop=sequence.Loop} end
end end
local current,startTime,blendStart,previous="Idle",os.clock(),os.clock(),{}
local function play(name)
    if not clips[name] then return end
    previous={};for name,m in pairs(motors) do previous[name]=m.Transform end
    current=name;startTime=os.clock();blendStart=startTime;rig:SetAttribute("PreviewAnimation",name)
end
local function prompt(name,key,text,choices)
    local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment");attachment.Name=name.."Attachment";attachment.Position=Vector3.new(0,1,0);attachment.Parent=rig.HumanoidRootPart
    local p=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");p.Name=name;p.ActionText=text;p.ObjectText="Ashen Oath — манекен"
    p.KeyboardKeyCode=key;p.HoldDuration=0;p.MaxActivationDistance=12;p.RequiresLineOfSight=false
    p.Exclusivity=Enum.ProximityPromptExclusivity.AlwaysShow;p.UIOffset=Vector2.new(0,key==Enum.KeyCode.E and -35 or 35);p.Parent=attachment
    local index=0
    p.Triggered:Connect(function() index=index%#choices+1;play(choices[index]) end)
end
prompt("AttackPreview",Enum.KeyCode.E,"Показать следующий удар",{"Light_01","Light_02","Light_03","Heavy_Release","Running_Attack","Thrust"})
prompt("DefensePreview",Enum.KeyCode.F,"Показать защиту / парирование",{"Guard_Enter","Guard_Impact","Parry","Riposte","Guard_Break"})
rig:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RequestedPreviewAnimation"):Connect(function()
    local name=rig:GetAttribute("RequestedPreviewAnimation");if typeof(name)=="string" then play(name) end
end)
play("Idle")
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
    -- Allow native AnimationTracks and the Animation Editor to take over the rig.
    if #animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()>0 then return end
    local clip=clips[current];local now=os.clock();local t=now-startTime
    if t>clip.duration then
        if clip.loop then t=t%math.max(clip.duration,.001)
        else play("Idle");clip=clips.Idle;t=0 end
    end
    local frames=clip.frames;local a,b=frames[1],frames[#frames]
    for i=1,#frames-1 do if t>=frames[i].time and t<=frames[i+1].time then a,b=frames[i],frames[i+1];break end end
    local alpha=b.time>a.time and math.clamp((t-a.time)/(b.time-a.time),0,1) or 0
    local blend=math.clamp((now-blendStart)/.12,0,1);blend=blend*blend*(3-2*blend)
    for name,m in pairs(motors) do
        local cf=(a.poses[name] or CFrame.identity):Lerp(b.poses[name] or CFrame.identity,alpha)
        m.Transform=(previous[name] or CFrame.identity):Lerp(cf,blend)
    end
end)
